# Convocation for Conferring Degrees

Faculty of Engineering Class of 2026

Tuesday, June 16, 9:00am

## Land Acknowledgement

McMaster University recognizes and acknowledges that we meet today on the traditional territories of the Mississauga and Haudenosaunee nations within the lands protected by the Dish With One Spoon wampum agreement.

## Presiding

Chancellor Nicholas Brathwaite, BA (Hons), BA, MA

President and Vice-Chancellor Dr. Susan Tighe, PhD, PEng FCAE, FCSCE, FEIC, C.Dir

Visit registrar.mcmaster.ca/ convocation-2026 to learn more about the Honorary Degree recipients, award winners and valedictorians.

The McMaster University convocation program is a listing of degree candidates who have been approved for Spring convocation by the May 22, 2026 deadline. Publishing names of degree candidates in the ceremony program is not a verification of completion of degree requirements.
